title: Bridgeport Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Bridgeport is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 30 ROBERT'S WAYWelcome to Bridgeport | A Rosewalk Retreat in Seaside, FloridaTucked into the charming Rosewalk area of Seaside, FL, Bridgeport is a cheerful pink beach bungalow designed for relaxed coastal living. Sleeping up to eight guests, this inviting cottage offers a prime location just 176 yards (a 3-minute walk) to the beach and an easy 7-minute stroll to Seaside’s Central Square, where more than 35 shops and restaurants await. Perfectly positioned along Robert’s Way and backing up to Rosewalk Park, Bridgeport delivers a rare blend of walkability, privacy, and serene park views.Outdoor Living Overlooking Rosewalk ParkOne of Bridgeport’s standout features is its screened rear porch, which overlooks the sandy paths and shaded trees of Rosewalk Park—a true hidden gem in Seaside. With bar-top seating for two and a porch swing, this peaceful space is ideal for morning coffee, afternoon reading, or an evening glass of wine while the kids play below. The park setting creates a calm, tucked-away feel while still being moments from the heart of town.Bright, Open First-Floor LivingInside, the first level welcomes guests with a bright, open-concept living space featuring comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV—perfect for gathering after a beach day. The updated, fully equipped kitchen sits just off the living area and includes bar-top seating for four, making it easy to prep beach lunches or enjoy casual family meals together. The open layout creates a warm, communal atmosphere ideal for entertaining and relaxing alike.Comfortable Bedrooms & Flexible Sleeping SpacesThe first floor includes two bedrooms, offering convenience and flexibility. The queen guest bedroom features abundant natural light, a flat-screen TV, ample storage, and a private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. The second bedroom is a fun bunk room that sleeps two and includes a window seat, closet space, and a loft area accessed by a ship’s ladder—perfect for kids. A nearby full bathroom with a shower serves this space.Upstairs, guests will find a secondary living area with a sofa and cushioned seating—an ideal retreat for reading, relaxing, or quiet conversation. Adjacent to this space is a private sleeping nook with a full bed, accommodating two additional guests. Step outside to the open-air upper balcony, furnished with Adirondack bar-top seating for two and overlooking the tranquil park setting—an ideal spot to unwind at sunset.A Colorful Seaside FavoriteWith its unbeatable location, peaceful park views, and thoughtfully designed living spaces, Bridgeport is a standout choice for families or groups seeking a classic Seaside experience. Walk to the beach, bike to town, and return home to a cheerful cottage that feels both tucked away and perfectly connected—your next favorite Seaside getaway awaits.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES870 square feet of comfortable coastal living spacePrivate Seaside residential beach access at Tupelo Pavilion, part of the largest private residential beach on Scenic 30A176 yards (approximately a 1-minute walk) to beach access and a 7-minute walk to the Seaside AmphitheaterAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest services throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two bedroom and larger homes issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowedSTR24-001467
